# Moist physics coupling {#sec-ch10}

This chapter is about how phase change and condensates enter snapy's step. The equations of state and the phase
equilibrium itself are Chapter 2 (@sec-ch02-saturation); this chapter starts where they are called. It covers the
saturation adjustment's place in the step; the two causes for rejecting a step that moist physics raises; the two
species repairs of the conserved limiter, which keep condensate and vapour non-negative without creating mass; the
reaction kinetics that the example drivers, not the library, run between steps; passive tracers carried per unit
dry air; and the settling of condensates. One rule runs through all of them: latent heat is never a separate term.
It is the difference of the species reference energies, so every operator here except sedimentation writes the
species rows only and leaves the total energy, the momentum and the dry air alone. Sedimentation moves condensate
with its own energy and momentum. The redo machinery in general is Chapter 7 and the positivity limiter's theory
Chapter 8.

| scheme | switch | default | order | main test |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Saturation adjustment (@sec-ch10-satadj) | reactions in the thermo | on with reactions | n/a | `test_wall_saturation` |
| Redo causes (@sec-ch10-redo) | `max_redo` | 5 | n/a | `test_check_redo_saturation` |
| Parent-vapour borrow (@sec-ch10-borrow) | `limiter` | off | n/a | `test_condensate_conservation` |
| Column vapour repair (@sec-ch10-fixvapor) | `limiter` | off | n/a | `test_fix_vapor_volume` |
| Driver kinetics (@sec-ch10-kinetics) | driver | driver | 1 in time | `test_uranus_cycle1_abort` |
| Dry-air tracers (@sec-ch10-tracer) | `scalar` | off | as `reconstruct` | `test_tracer_dry_convention` |
| Sedimentation (@sec-ch10-sed) | `sedimentation` | off | 1 in space | `test_sedimentation_guards` |

: The schemes of this chapter, their switches and defaults, and the test that carries each one. "Driver" means
the scheme is in the example drivers, not in the library, and has no library switch. `limiter` defaults to
false both in the C++ options struct and in YAML. Full ctest names and tolerances are in each scheme's Tests
layer and in @sec-ch15-ch10-tests. {#tbl-ch10-schemes}
